sentences.text:
In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Appeal No. Of 2025
 (@ Special Leave Petition (Crl.) No.8153/2025)
RUPESH RAM ...APPELLANT  VERSUS  THE STATE OF JHARKHAND & ANR. .RESPONDENT  O R D E R Leave granted.
This appeal challenges the order dated 28.02.2025 passed by the High Court of Jharkhand at Ranchi in A.B.A. No. 1179 of 2025.

entities.text: High Court of Jharkhand at Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Apprehending arrest in connection with FIR No.114/2023 dated 01.09.2023 registered at Police Station  Senha, District  Lohardaga for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 323, 376, 504,
506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, the appellant preferred an application before the High Court seeking anticipatory bail.
Said application for anticipatory bail has been rejected by the High Court vide the impugned order dated 28.02.2025.
Hence, the instant appeal has been preferred.
By order dated 21.04.2025, this Court issued notice to the respondent and ordered that no coercive steps be taken as against the appellant herein provided he cooperates with the investigation.
We have heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned counsel for the respondent(s) and perused the material on record.

Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that the relationship between the appellant and the so-called victim was consensual in nature; that false and frivolous allegations have been made as against the appellant herein but the appellant has cooperated with the investigation.
He submitted that by order dated 21.04.2025, this Court had granted interim protection and therefore, the said order may be made absolute.
Also having regard to the ailment (Carcinoma) the appellant is suffering from, relief may be granted to the appellant by setting aside the impugned order.

Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State as well as learned counsel for respondent no.2/complainant with reference to their counter affidavits submitted that there is no real cooperation in the investigation inasmuch the appellant has not provided the digital material as against the second respondent herein and there is a threat that same may be made viral and thereby Rupesh Ram vs The State Of Jharkhand on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76319428/
1 affecting the second respondents right to privacy.

sentences.text: They, therefore, submitted that there is no merit in this appeal and the same may be dismissed.
Considering the circumstances on record, in our view, the appellant is entitled to the relief claimed.
We, therefore, allow this appeal and set-aside the order passed by the High Court.

We direct that in the event of arrest of the appellant, the Arresting Officer shall release the appellant on bail, subject to furnishing cash security of the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty-Five Thousand only) with two like sureties.
It is directed that the appellant shall extend complete cooperation in the ensuing investigation/trial.
The appellant shall not misuse their liberty and shall not in any way influence the witnesses or tamper with the material on record.
Any infraction of the conditions shall entail cancellation of anticipatory bail granted to the appellant.

The appellant to file an affidavit of undertaking before this Court within a period of three weeks from today to the effect that he shall not make viral any digital material that he has or in any manner disseminate vis--vis the second respondent/victim.

In the event, the said affidavit of undertaking has not filed within the aforesaid time before this Court, liberty is reserved to the respondent(s) herein to seek cancellation of the anticipatory bail granted by this Court in accordance with law.
With the aforesaid directions, the criminal appeal is allowed.

J. [B.V. NAGARATHNA] .J. [K.V.
VISWANATHAN] NEW DELHI DECEMBER 05, 2025 ITEM
